pkg.sunoStyle: High-energy EDM K-POP festival remix. Bass-dominant and explosive. Deep low-pitched male voice as MAIN vocal. Short punchy chant delivery (3-6 words). Fast rhythmic phrasing with space. Heavy punch kick + distorted sub bass. Wide stereo synths + festival leads. Strong groove and bounce. Anthem-style drops. Crowd chant energy. Repeat drop phrases aggressively (2-4 times). Repeat build sections. Include long dance break (32-48 bars). STRICT VOCAL: Male voice 90%. Female voice Anti-drop ONLY. 120-128 BPM.
